messages.content:
You are the duty assistant of a data-centre facility team during the first hour of an event. You apply one approved intelligence pill and nothing else.

You see only what the team knew in the first hour ("signals"). You do not know how the event ended.

Rules:
1. Every action you recommend must come from a rule in the pill; give that rule's id. Do not invent actions or numbers.
2. Classify: "recurring" if the signals clearly meet the "when" conditions of one or more rules; "partly_recurring" if some rules apply but the signals also show something no rule addresses; "novel" if no rule applies.
3. Anything that matters but no rule covers goes into "not_covered", and then escalate.
4. Follow the guardrails.
5. Order next_actions by urgency.

Reply with JSON only:
{"classification":"recurring|partly_recurring|novel","matched_rules":[{"rule_id":"R-001","because":"...","signals":["SRC:S1"]}],"next_actions":[{"action":"...","rule_id":"R-001"}],"escalate":{"now":true,"to":"...","reason":"..."},"not_covered":["..."]}

{"site":"South Central US region, one datacenter (San Antonio area, Texas)","signals":[{"id":"AZ-SCUS-2018:S7","t_plus_min":0,"text":"At 08:42 UTC, lightning caused electrical activity on the utility supply, which caused significant voltage swells."},{"id":"AZ-SCUS-2018:S8","t_plus_min":0,"text":"These swells triggered a portion of one Azure datacenter to transfer from utility power to generator power."},{"id":"AZ-SCUS-2018:S9","t_plus_min":0,"text":"Additionally, these power swells shutdown the datacenter’s mechanical cooling systems despite having surge suppressors in place."},{"id":"AZ-SCUS-2018:S10","t_plus_min":0,"text":"Initially, the datacenter was able to maintain its operational temperatures through a load dependent thermal buffer that was designed within the cooling system."},{"id":"AZ-SCUS-2018:S25","t_plus_min":47,"text":"Customer impact began at approximately 09:29 UTC when storage servers in the datacenter began shutting down as a result of unsafe temperatures."}],"pill":{"pill":"dc-cooling-loss@1.0.0","scope":{"assets":["data halls cooled by chilled-water plant (chillers, pumps, chilled-water loop)","utility and generator power feeding that plant"],"not_for":["IT service recovery and failover","fire suppression and life safety (follow the site emergency plan)"]},"rules":[],"guardrails":[]}}

response: {"classification": "novel", "matched_rules": [], "next_actions": [], "escalate": {"now": true, "to": "facility duty manager / site emergency coordinator", "reason": "Pill dc-cooling-loss@1.0.0 has zero rules; signals show utility voltage swells, transfer to generator, mechanical cooling shutdown from swells, thermal buffer used, and storage servers shutting down from unsafe temps at T+47 — none addressed by any rule."}, "not_covered": ["lightning-induced utility voltage swells causing generator transfer (S7,S8)", "mechanical cooling shutdown despite surge suppressors from power swells (S9)", "load-dependent thermal buffer maintaining temps initially (S10)", "storage servers shutting down due to unsafe temperatures at T+47 (S25)"]}
